Seat rulings on the pre-claim report (`/mnt/project-files/card-38135/pre-claim-report-5b8ca361.md`):
- Route: extend the runtime rewrite, and do not refuse at save. `today()` comparisons are already accepted and evaluated right under ADR-0032 §1c, and `addDays` returns the same Timestamp. None of the three rewrite conditions is loosened.
- Scope: one "call returns Timestamp" test replaces both hand-kept name lists, `operandKind` (:2405) and `isTemporalCall` (:1784). The equality path also takes `date`/`datetime`, from the same root cause. A drift pin enumerates every stdlib Timestamp signature.
- The premise is wider than the card: `==` against `addDays`/`date()`/`timestamp()` silently answers false, and the flow is skipped. Both are fixed here.
- Ask 2: the doors do not change under this route. Each door gets an "accepted without error" control, and the runtime pins carry the behaviour.
- Metadata-protocol: `semantic` (minor). A spelling the doors already accept now means what it says at run time, so deployed flows that skipped or failed start firing. The changeset says so in plain words.
File surface:
- `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`: the Timestamp-returning test, used by `rewriteFaultedOperands` and `rewriteTemporalCallEquality`.
- `packages/formula/src/cel-overload-retry-scope.test.ts` and the #3183 describe in `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.test.ts`: comparison and equality pins with `today()`/`daysFromNow()` controls, the drift pin, and ablations.
- A `packages/services/service-automation` runtime pin: a flow whose `addDays` condition fires, and an equality one on the matching day.
- One `.changeset/*.md` (`@objectstack/formula` minor).
Stop on breach and explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:thread`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates.mjs --tier: "no path-derived mandate"`, `effort: high`, reason: the thread session serves effort high
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Responsibility: a flow, validation or automation condition that compares `addDays(today(), N)` (or `addMonths`, `addWorkingDays`, `addWorkingHours`, `timestamp()`, `date()`, `datetime()`) with a date field evaluates at run time the way the `today()` comparison does. It never passes at save and then fails or silently answers false at every run.
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds and is wider than the card, measured on origin/main 5b8ca361 (report above)
Serial constraints cleared: `none — no open PR touches packages/formula; #35295 edits validate.ts, a different file`
